tests.name: ops/attention still mounted and exafy_admin-gated (unauthenticated read)

tests.reason: Staging tests are read-only (rule 48) and never sign in here, so this suite cannot see the cloudwatch_alarms source itself: whether it reads ok on staging (grant applied, flag on) can only be confirmed by an exafy_admin signed in to the staging Command Hub Overview (Platform & Services tile, sources fresh 2/2) or GET /api/v1/ops/attention with an admin token (sources[].id == cloudwatch_alarms, status ok). The read (pagination, ALARM filter, cap, throw on AccessDenied/timeout), the P1/P2 rubric, the flag gate (off -> not monitored, on + AccessDenied -> unknown) and the aggregator default are proven in CI with a fake SDK client; no AWS call is made by any test.
